Big coins which aren't affected by P switches.
Comes in 10, 30, and 50 coin versions, and includes a sparkle effect (as an extended sprite).

v1.1

name: smwblocks-8-directional-cannon-blocks
title: 8-Directional Cannon Blocks
description:
These block contains 16 cannon blocks, button-dependent and automatic ones, each with 8 different directions, as well as 2 stopper blocks and a solid block that is only passable when Mario is being launched.

When launched, Mario will shoot in a straight line, so place them carefully.

The button based cannons are used if the player is waiting for enemies to get out of his way, whereas the automatic ones are used for areas to blast the player from one place to another quickly.

Changelog
(12/7/2025)
* Fixed a label being uppercase confusing UberASMTool 2.0 and newer.

(10/2/2022)

* Made to work with UberASM Tool

* Added defines for the sound the cannons make

name: smwblocks-accurate-hitbox-hurt-kill-block
title: Accurate Hitbox Hurt/Kill Block
description:
A hurt / death block with proper hitbox, meant to be used for kaizo / pit hacks.

Typical Blockreator hurt / death blocks use the coin hitbox, which differs from the vanilla muncher / cement block / spikes hitbox in two ways:
1) the coin hitbox is 1 pixel wider on each side
2) the top edge of a muncher doesn't hurt you when moving upward
These differences are very apparent in kaizo / pit hacks and can be frustrating for the player. This block fixes both of them.

Includes the following configuration options:
- hurt / instant death
- solid / passable for sprites
- walk on top with Yoshi
- disable wall running

name: smwblocks-achievement-doors
title: Achievement Doors
description:
Requested by bandicoot

These doors will only work if the following conditions are met:

- Found at least "X" number of exits during the game
- Collected the dragon coins in at least "X" number of levels
- Collected the moon in at least a "X" number of levels
- Have at least "X" number of bonus stars
- Have at least "X" number of lives
- Have "X" amount of coins
- Have "X" amount of silver coins

name: smwblocks-air-jump-blocks-v2
title: Air Jump Blocks v2.1
description:
When Mario touches this non-solid block, it allows him to jump off while in mid-air when you press the (spin) jump button. Perfect for platforming levels.

Notes: you can only jump if Mario is falling, not rising (so press jump when Mario is falling to make this work).
Another thing is if you make a staircase of this block, change 0x07A78 from [D0] to [80] to allow free vertical scrolling so the screen won't obscure Mario on top of the screen.

Credit not necessary.

-compatable with water on/off levels

-remove having stompable enemies around these block makes consecutive 1-up stomp possible if more than 1 screen line of this blocks, now resets the consecutive stomp counter if mario jumps off.

name: smwblocks-basic-teleport-block
title: Basic Teleport Block
description: A simple teleport block. Cam be made to use the screen exit or to use a hardcoded location.

name: smwblocks-black-piranha-plant-muncher-v1
title: Black Piranha Plant (Muncher) v1.1
description:
An expanded muncher from Super Mario World.
-Can be a reverse muncher (as in, it starts as a coin, but if you trigger the silver P-Switch, changes to a muncher).
- Can choose what switch turns it from muncher to coin.
- Can configure which side won't hurt the player while being a muncher.

It retains the "side touch" hitbox, meaning that if the player touches the side without overlapping it (by moving straight up and down on it, NOT moving against it), it won't hurt them.

name: smwblocks-carriable-cement-block
title: Carriable Cement Block
description:
This is a cement block, but it can be picked up and thrown around! When grabbed, it will turn into a cement block sprite, and will revert back to a carryable cement block (or any configurable Map16 tile) when it hits a wall, gets carried into an enemy, or its carry timer runs out (also configurable).
Includes the "spawner" block, the carryable block sprite, and ExGFX (overwrites the "Cloud Game Coin" in SP2).

Credit is unnecessary but appreciated.

A few things to consider:

- It is possible in some cases to be killed by the sprite when it turns back into a block; this is more likely when you're running and carrying the block sprite. This is because blocks can only be a minimum of 16 pixels apart, so when the sprite reverts to a block, it snaps to the nearest 16-pixel "square". In some cases this can make it overlap with Mario enough that he gets killed inside the block.
- The block works relatively well with layer 2, and can snap to tile positions pretty closely even with variable scrolling and layer 2 scroll commands. It's not always perfect though.
- Since this becomes a sprite when grabbed, the amount you can have active at once is limited by the number of sprite slots. They also don't despawn when offscreen, so be careful if you intend on having a lot of them in a level/area at one time.
To make them despawn when offscreen, open the .json in PIXI's CFG editor, uncheck the "Process when offscreen" box, save, then re-insert the sprite.
- To avoid cutoff on certain objects and potential level breaks/cheeses, the block sprite will only revert back to a block if the current Map16 tile at its position is air. Otherwise, it will simply vanish. This is layer-dependent though, so a layer 2-spawned block sprite could revert if it was in front of a layer 1 bush tile, so long as the layer 2 tile it's at was air.

name: smwblocks-change-acts-like-when-slippery
title: Change Acts Like When Slippery
description: This block will change acts like settings if the level is slippery.

name: smwblocks-coin-outline
title: Coin Outline
description:
This is a New Super Mario Bros. coin outline, which turns into a coin after a configurable amount of time.
In order for this block to work, insert the included UberASMTool code as level code.
Requires 240 bytes of free RAM.

Graphics included ripped by larenlarsenv and Soul.

name: smwblocks-custom-turnblock-v1
title: Custom Turnblock v1.1
description:
A turnblock that behaves mostly like the original. Useful for changing palettes or customizing the asm.

Requires PIXI 1.40 for the included bounce sprite.

Check the readme file for adjustments that may be required to ensure proper functionality.

Note: hitting more than 4 at a time will not revert to the turnblock, but some blocks will be left spinning forever.

Note: blocks on layer 2 moving down will crush the player instead of activating the block.

v1.1 (Arinsu)
---
* Added the functionality to also make the turnblock turn when spinjumping it.

name: smwblocks-diagonal-up-pipes-v1
title: Diagonal Up Pipes v1.1
description:
Diagonal pipes you can enter the same way as normal pipes (well you do need to hold up and right/left)

Thanks to Bob66, now includes GFX and a map16 file to work with.

Requires asar, GPS and uberASM to work properly, see readme file for instructions.

New in 1.1 :
- Small pipes included
- Anti-clip helper blocks
- GFX and map16 files (Thanks, Bob66)

name: smwblocks-directional-hurt-blocks-v1
title: Directional Hurt Blocks v1.2
description:
Unlike the hurt specific sides block, this block has a lot of improvements and features:

-the sides of the block does not hurt the player if the player is touching the side unless he moves towards or into the block (smw munchers and spikes (from castle and ghost houses) does this), by checking if mario's hitbox pixel is either overlapping (at least 1 pixel) it or adjacent to the block.

-various options like killing the player instantly regardless of powerup (or HP if using HP patch), killing sprites and more!

Update 1.2 (DrAnas): converted all the blocks to SA-1 and included slippery versions of the blocks for use with GHB's perfect slippery blocks!

name: smwblocks-disappearing-block-v2
title: Disappearing Block v2.3
description:
A block that disappears shortly after Mario walks on it.


Changelog:
v2.3
Works on wall jumps.
Reduced unnecessary processing.

v2.2
Now works with layer 2.

v2.0
Switched from sprite to uberasm.

name: smwblocks-end-level-coin
title: End Level Coin
description: This coin ends the level after a certain amount is collected. It can either be a regular coin, or use a custom counter. It can trigger the regular exit or any of the three secret exits.

name: smwblocks-end-level-on-button-press
title: End Level on Button Press
description: This block ends the level after a certain button is pressed.

name: smwblocks-endless-throw-block
title: Endless Throw Block
description:
The ol' infinite or endless supply throw block. This is a simple block that spawns a throw block in Mario's hands when touching it and pressing grab. It has an option to make it a limited-spawner (melts other blocks).

Credit unnecessary.

name: smwblocks-event-dependent-block-v-1
title: Event Dependent Block V.1.21
description:
This block will act like another block when certain event is activated.

Be sure to check readme for more details.

Requested by Gi Manilla

name: smwblocks-force-yoshi-dismount
title: Force Yoshi Dismount
description:
This block is a gate that prevents Mario from riding Yoshi through, without outright killing Yoshi. It will force the player to dismount Yoshi, and optionally stop Yoshi from passing at all (preventing "throwing" Yoshi through the block with his momentum).

Useful if you want to restrict Yoshi within an area, but also allow the player to return to him.

Requires a small hijack to prevent cheesing Yoshi through the block with quick mount-dismounts. An unpatch is included.

name: smwblocks-invincibility-while-ducking
title: Invincibility While Ducking
description:
This block will make the player invincible when they're ducking, either when standing on it or while inside it. Inspired by this patch I made a while ago.

Includes an assortment of visual effects, such as going behind layers, flashing, sparkling, and setting custom poses.

name: smwblocks-jump-activated-spikes-hurt-blocks-v1-1
title: Jump-Activated Spikes/Hurt Blocks v1.1.1
description:
These blocks will change every time the player jumps.
Requested by mr bean6652.

v1.1 (Arinsu)
---
- Added SA-1 support.
- Added a define to not hurt the player while on Yoshi on the above variant of the spikes.
- Added a Map16 page.

name: smwblocks-key-lock-blocks
title: Key Lock Blocks
description:
This package contains many key block barriers in different shapes:

-A 2 block long (vertically and horizontally)
-A 3 block long (vertically and horizontally)
-A 32x32 px (2x2 16x16) block

And also an option if you want a stackable key counter like in the zelda series.

name: smwblocks-ledge-vine
title: Ledge Vine
description: This block acts like a ledge if the player is standing on top of the block, but pressing down makes it act like a vine. Unlike 'Vinecloud', this one sets a value in RAM address $8B that allows the climbing flag to be set so that the player doesn't just fall if not pressing down. When climbing up from a vine below it, the player will pop up into the air and land on the top of the ledge.

name: smwblocks-mario-interactable-1f0
title: Mario Interactable 1F0
description:
Mario got tired of seeing the sprites having fun in 1F0's and now he wants to join the party!
What if Mario would be able to interact with them?
This is the official release of a block posted on 2023 C3.
Use as 1F0 to interact with other sprites or 25 to Mario-only.

This includes an L/R reset(death) in case players get stuck.

name: smwblocks-no-jump-block
title: No Jump Block
description: This block disables Mario's jump and/or spinjump when Mario is touching it from above. It's pretty customisable, as it can be configured to only restrict Mario's jump on certain conditions (on/off switch, blue/silver p-switch and Mario is in water/starman/on Yoshi). Check the asm file for those customization options.

name: smwblocks-pass-through-ledge-by-pressing-a
title: Pass-Through Ledge by Pressing A
description:
Unlike other passable ledges, this one requires the player to hold down and tap A to fall through. This is useful if you want the player to have freedom to duck and duck-jump without having to fall through.

However, if the player is riding Yoshi, it requires only to tap down to fall through.

name: smwblocks-pipe-cannon
title: Pipe Cannon
description:
This is a pipe cannon similar to the one New Super Mario Bros.
If the player enters it, instead of warping them to another level, it shoots them straight up into the air, locking their controls during launch.
Mario will keep going until he hits a ceiling, or one of 2 custom blocks: 
PipeCannon_End.asm
or 
PipeCannon_teleport.asm
.
Also included is a variant that will shoot the player when they press A or B instead of waiting for a timer.

Useful for a gimmick like getting to high areas disguised as a pipe to nowhere.

name: smwblocks-powerup-coin
title: Powerup Coin
description: A coin that gives the player a powerup of their choice, as well as a configurable amount of coins. Becomes solid when the blue P-Switch is active.

name: smwblocks-purple-coins
title: Purple Coins
description:
A replica of the purple coins from Super Mario Galaxy. Collect a certain amount of them (customisable) and activate something (also customisable).
These coins stay collected if you switch to a different room.

Be sure to read the readme before inserting the coins!

Requested by MrMartley64.

name: smwblocks-rock-climb-blocks
title: Rock Climb Blocks
description:
These 2 blocks act as "mini ledges" that can only be stand on if the player does the following:

-Not crouching
-Holding in the direction towards the wall.
-Touching the wall, a pixel or more away does not count.

name: smwblocks-shatter-after-player-touch-v2
title: Shatter After Player Touch v2.0
description:
This custom block will shatter after the player gets off it. Good for platforming stages or places where you jump a lot to dodge stuff.

Requested by Final Theory.

---
- Added SA-1 compatibility.

name: smwblocks-sprite-shatter-blocks
title: Sprite Shatter Blocks
description: A pack of blocks which shatter upon sprite contact. Inspired by the original BlockTool's Mega Mole shatter blocks.

name: smwblocks-stationary-re-usable-p-switch
title: Stationary Re-Usable P-Switch
description: Unlike smw's p-switches, these p-switches are stationary and can be used multiple times, useful for puzzle levels for those who dislike having to reset.

name: smwblocks-super-mario-bros-3-screen-scrolling-pipes-v4-0
title: Super Mario Bros. 3 Screen Scrolling Pipes v4.0.4
description:
See tutorial here. The blocks section has a small 1MIB limit preventing me from submitting this as a whole.

These pipes, when entered, will cause the player to travel through them within the same level rather than refreshing the screen. Useful for maze levels for those who refuse to use screen exits.

Notes:
* If there are at least 2 sprites on screen, and Mario enters a pipe, he will partially disappear as he enters a pipe. You should patch NMSTL to prevent that.
* If you have a low-gravity generator that does 
DEC $7D
(Mario's Y speed), make sure that you add a check that if $9D is nonzero, or the low nibble (low 4 bits, %----XXXX) of RAM address 
!pipe_dir
is non-zero, then skip/return, because otherwise Mario will rise up slowly while traveling through horizontal pipes. You absolutely don't want to touch his physics while inside pipes.

GitHub: https://github.com/GhbSmwc/SMB3_ScreenScrollingPipes

Changelog
01-01-2025 4.0.3

	-Fixed an oversight where some sprites still interacts with the player while inside a pipe, such as

	 a boo ring. Give thanks to AmperSam for reporting on it.

12/26/2025 4.0.4

	-Bug fixes:

	--Fixed a missing TopCorner for small pipes that I forgot to include for small-mario-only pipes.

	--Fixed a problem where sprite interaction with the player during pipe travel still happens (lose yoshi)

	  when the player is riding yoshi.

	--Fixed a problem where if player is off yoshi, and enters a pipe and turns invisible, so too will

	  yoshi. Credit to AmperSam (https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=profile&id=41223). Note that this isn't a

	  true fix since yoshi checks if RAM $78 is #$FF would hide him. Problem is that the yoshi routine

	  that checks the RAM is hijacked by SA-1.

	--Fixed a minor visual quirk where if the player crouch-slide into the top of a pipe and enters it,

	  the player will retain his crouching state throughout the pipe travel.

	--Fixed an issue with Warp/Drag mode in SA-1 breaking on accurate emulators (when applied to SA-1 game,

	  the main pipes code for UAT's gamemode 14 would still run in SNES CPU, runs an aiming routine that

	  would use SA-1 math registers, which would fail). This now invokes SA-1 when the game is SA-1.

	--Fixed a slight error where dying the same frame the player enters a pipe with !Setting_SSP_FreezeTime

	  set to 1 would cause an abrupt fade out on the dying animation.

	--Fixed a bug where yoshi turning around animation persists when traveling through vertical pipes.

	--Made horizontal pipes also set X position and vertical pipes set Y position in addition to centering

	  the player so that the player goes from entering to stem state at a consistent position (sprites,

	  wind generators or anything that would position the player slightly off can affect this).

	-Added an optional fix for camera panning to allow the camera to pan in the direction the player is

	 facing when enabling freezing during pipe travel (previously, the camera would pan in front of

	 player's facing when the freeze setting is off, but does not do so when on).

	-Player's XY Subpixels position (RAM $13DA and $13DC) updates:

	--Centering codes now also sets the player's XY subpixel position, thus movement no longer have a 1

	  pixel variance of the player's XY position upon exiting pipe caps.

	--Made an extremely minor change on "Fixes.asm" to include clearing the player's Y position subpixel

	  when standing on layer 1 & 2 platforms.

	 -Moved several block codes to subroutines:

	--Vertical centering code (accounting for whether or not riding yoshi or powerup states) now moved

	  to subroutines.

	--Majority of the code handling exiting vertical pipe caps and turn corners now moved to block

	  subroutines, saving significant space.

	-!Freeram_SSP_EntrExtFlg updated to now have values for entering, stem traveling, exiting normally,

	 and cannon exiting. Also the defines now reflect on this.

	-Renamed several routine files to have a "SSP" at the beginning of the name using freeram of screen

	 scrolling pipes (It's better to have ASM resource-specific routines have their name (in this case,

	 "screen scrolling pipes") in so that (1) reduce the risk of filename conflicts, and (2) be more

	 informative that it is resource-specific).

	-Vertical regular-sized pipe caps and turn corners will now check if the player is centered enough to

	 trigger them. This allows setups like seen here:

	 "Readme_files/VerticalExitCapsRequirePlayerCenteredHorizontally.png"

	--Did a similar thing with the warp/drag mode block as well as the new "set_visibility_off.asm" and

	  "set_visibility_on.asm", however it accepts both single-block centered and 2-block centered (half

	  block to the right).

	-Added an option !Setting_SSP_HideDuringPipeStemTravel, which can be set to 0 so that the player and

	 carried sprite does not turn invisible inside pipes, ideal for glass pipes.

	-Map16 files for LM's map16 and tile list for GPS for "v2" versions now have page 4 and page 5 merged

	 rather than having one file per-page.

	-Depreciated files:

	--Deleted the old version of the map16 blocks and for the GPS tool.

	--Got rid of the old level file since it is now depreciated and causing confusion.

	-Made moving blocks to a different block number for blocks list for GPS much MUCH easier, by including

	 a tool, "JS_GPSBlockListRelocator.html" which will offset them to a different map16 number.

	-Facing directions are now corrected when traveling through pipes rather than just when the player

	 exits horizontal pipe caps, so that the player doesn't appear going backwards in glass pipes.

	-The uberasm tool code is no longer a library code to be called from a gamemode 14 ASM file, because

	 UAT2.0 now supports multiple separate ASM files for the same N where N is the level/gamemode/

	 overworld number to apply its effects on.

	-Added a per-level wraparound feature for warp-drag mode: If the player pipe traveling heads into the

	 edge of a level, will send him to the opposite edge of the level. If V/H scrolling disabled, then

	 wraparound will adjust to be the screen's width. It also comes with an extra byte setting to also

	 invert along the edge.

	-Added a uberasm tool level file that adds wraparound effect for screen scrolling pipes when the

	 traveling player hits the edge of the level.

	-Several removed freerams:

	--Late discovery that somebody (MarioFanGamer) found that RAM $8F is a reliable copy of $72 for

	  checking if Mario is on the ground. Thus, freeram !Freeram_BlockedStatBkp will optionally not be used

	  (!Setting_SSP_CopyRAM77 set to 0 by default to not use a freeram).

	--Removing !Freeram_SSP_CarrySpr would still works with carried sprites. Thus this is redundant.

	-Added optional Freeram: !Freeram_SSP_InvisbleFlag, due to having both visible and invisible states for

	 doors and glass pipe support (will be used if !Setting_SSP_HideDuringPipeStemTravel == 0).

	-Added walking animation for horizontal pipe caps (note that it runs the vanilla code that handles

	 walking animations, as seen when $71 == #$05), which are JSL $00CEB1, JSL $00CFBC and

	 JSR $00D1F4. Finally fulfilled RPG Hacker's recommendation (https://smwc.me/s/41236/12725 ).

	-Moved aiming routine used by warp/drag mode to newer uberasm tool's routines.

	-Added an optional feature for warp/drag mode to make the player move faster if the destination is far

	 away enough.

	-Renamed various defines that start with "!SSP" with "!Setting_SSP" for consistency.

	-Sound effects can now be configured.

name: smwblocks-super-mario-bros-wonder-marimba-blocks
title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder - Marimba Blocks
description:
Those silly little noteblock variants from Super Mario Bros. Wonder! You can walk or run on them, and when you jump, it bounces you up!

The block has a few configuration options you'll need to set in the block. Please read the README to learn what to set!

The sprite also has configuration options for the palettes it uses, the sprite tile, and how high it launches the player.

Further usage instructions are in the README.

NOTE: Dismounting Yoshi on top of one of these blocks will still bounce you high.

Teleports the player if all switch palaces have been pressed.

Teleports the player depending on in an overworld event has been triggered.

Teleports the player if they have a certain amount of lives.

Teleports the player if they have a certain powerup.

description: Teleports the player when touched by a specific sprite.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-switch
title: Teleport on Switch
description:
Teleports the player if a switch (blue or silver P-Switch, ON/OFF, switch palace, or even a custom free RAM switch) is active.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-time
title: Teleport on Time
description:
Teleports the player depending on the time limit.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

Note that this uses decimal mode and due an old bug in the SD2SNES/FXPak, issues might occur when using SA-1 in this flash cart. The newest firmware doesn't have this issue, so use that.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-yoshi-coins
title: Teleport on Yoshi Coins

Teleports the player if they have a certain amount of Yoshi coins.

name: smwblocks-teleport-on-yoshi-riding
title: Teleport on Yoshi Riding
description:
This block will teleport the player only if he is riding Yoshi.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

name: smwblocks-tower-of-heaven-fan
title: Tower of Heaven Fan
description:
Not to be confused with the simple blocks that DEC/SEC : SBC your $96 Y position to make you float.

This is a fan block that sends the player flying upwards in an acceleration-based momentum gradually unlike traditional boost blocks (which changes your momentum instantly). The longer or lower you are touching this block, the higher the player is sent. Inspired by the propellers from Tower of Heaven by askiisoft.

name: smwblocks-toxic-block-v1
title: Toxic Block v1.01
description:
This block will activate a timer when it is touched by Mario, and then hurt/kill Mario when the timer runs out. The timer resets every time Mario isn't touching a toxic block. Also an 8x8 sprite indicator will appear near Mario when the timer is close to running out.
Depending on the "Act as", you could make toxic water, air, cement, etc.

The zip contains two files: one is the block asm, which contains some parameters that can be edited to what you want and then it must be inserted with GPS, and the other must be inserted with UberASMTool (as level asm or gamemode asm) to make the blocks work properly. More information can be found in those files.

Update v1.01: the exclamation mark is now drawn accordingly to the direction that Mario is facing.

name: smwblocks-trampoline-block-v1
title: Trampoline Block v1.2
description:
Acts as 025 or 130.

Inspired by NSMB's Bouncy Mushrooms in World 1-5.

Unlike all other boost blocks, in order to bounce high, it requires the player to tap and hold the jump/spinjump button the instant they land on top of the block rather than also requiring just to hold the jump/spinjump button before landing.

Uses 3 bytes of freeram:
-!FreeRam_TimedJump is the margin of error range that allows the player to press a button within the window of time when bounced.
-!FreeRam_Ylow and !FreeRam_Yhi is a fix to prevent slightly higher jump.

name: smwblocks-walljump-blocks
title: Walljump Blocks
description:
A set of walljump blocks with the following features:
- The player cannot rear back early, with the left/right D-pad controls disabled temporarily so they cannot gain more height on the same wall.
- It changes the player's left/right facing direction while the timer is running.
